notes: Day 29 concludes: St. Demetrius completes from page 110 (¶፲ joined with 'ወሀሎ እስከ ይእዜ እንዘ ይገብር ተአምረ...'), followed by doxology ¶፲፩ ('ወስብሐት ለእግዚአብሔር...'), and Arke hymn for St. Demetrius ('ሰላም ለከ ድሜጥሮስ ሰማዕት...'). Commemorations: ¶፲፪ St. Sqtar/Siktar the martyr friend of Demetrius; ¶፲፫-፲፮ Repose of St. Tsekawa Dengel of Dabra Zanajana (አባ ጸቃውዐ ድንግል መምህር ዘደብረ ዘንጀና): youth, ordination, asceticism, succession to father. Paragraph 16 cuts at bottom of page ('በከመ ሥርዓተ ሐዋርያት' / 'እንደሐዋርያት ሥርዓት በጥሩ አጠባበቅ ጠበቃቸው') and completes on page 112. Line-by-line verified against page_111.png.
